<!-- 每节同时提供中文和英文；小改动可以各用一句话。 -->
<!-- Provide Chinese and English in each section; keep small changes concise. -->

- Scope / case: <!-- static/<case>, dynamic/<case>, or shared -->
- Related Issue / prerequisite PR: <!-- Optional for a small independent change. -->
- Base branch: <!-- main, or the explicit prerequisite branch for a stacked PR. -->

## 改动目的 / Purpose

**中文：**
<!-- 具体问题，以及改动后的行为。 -->

**English:**
<!-- The concrete problem and resulting behavior. -->

## 改动范围 / Changes

**中文：**
<!-- 关键模块与职责变化；说明默认行为、实验选项及依赖。 -->

**English:**
<!-- Key modules and responsibilities, defaults, experiments and dependencies. -->

## 验证结果 / Validation

**中文：**
<!-- 实际命令与结果；未执行的检查直接说明。只提供与改动相关的证据。 -->

**English:**
<!-- Commands and observed results, including checks not run. -->

<!-- 模型/性能改动：注明baseline、设备、输入、dtype/backend、质量及完整入口测量。 -->
<!-- Model/performance changes: name the baseline, device, inputs, dtype/backend, quality and complete-entry measurements. -->
<!-- 仿真改动：注明初态、调度、成功判据、控制步数预算和验证范围。 -->
<!-- Simulation changes: record initialization, schedule, success criterion, control-step budget and validation scope. -->

## 影响与回退 / Impact and Rollback

**中文：**
<!-- 接口/配置兼容性、数值或协议变化、恢复原行为的方法。 -->

**English:**
<!-- Compatibility, numerical/protocol changes and how to restore the previous behavior. -->
